about: Buildings for tools/art/meshy_building.py (Meshy text-to-3D, Smart Topology). Prompts lead with mass and silhouette and name few ornaments: the first barracks prompt listed every ornament and came back an open pavilion. The kingdom palette is the barracks' (commit ba16e76). Royal blue cloth is the owner-colour zone (teamHues); everything else keeps its painted colour. footprint is in cells; height is the tallest the model may stand, in metres, under the health bar. Walls, gates and gate leaves use fit stretch: they fill their box exactly so segments tile along X, and a leaf's box is its size in metres; triangles is their budget. Text-to-3D never gave a usable wall or gate, so those and the dwarf leaf name a base group instead of a prompt: meshy_building.py builds each culture's pieces in Blender at the game's exact size and one Meshy retexture paints them from the group's texture; a group's cloth colour dyes the banners and shields the builder made, where Meshy painted them some other colour. An entry's teamSaturation overrides its style's owner-colour gate. An entry's grade overrides its style's: the orc palisade came out darker than the orc houses and read as a black band in its own shadow. A leaf's texture replaces its style's house-shaped texture prompt for the refine.
